classification_policy.compatible_optional: The complete scene meaning supports the source's prerequisites and an optional distribution without adding an operation, participant, contact, phase, viewpoint or material constituent. This semantic label alone does not grant effect scope.
classification_policy.contradictory: The candidate's full meaning conflicts with an established request/core fact, an exclusion, or the frozen scope required for whole-row adoption.
classification_policy.unresolved: A prerequisite is not independently established; the candidate cannot supply it. No affirmative opposite fact is needed to withhold adoption.
classification_policy.whole_row_rule: Whole-row compatible_optional also requires all three declared dimensions explicitly open and all effects compatible. An omitted dimension is not open, even if it is not explicitly requester-locked.
classification_policy.inference_rule: Ordinary action meanings may establish their normal working contact without verbatim source wording. Inferred contact is identified below; it cannot justify changing the frozen hand, tool, approach or view.
classification_policy.independence: Reviewer classifications are not consumer instructions, ranking labels, predicted wins or permission to modify either source or case inputs. No retrieval outputs were read.

swath.P2: Existing tool-to-surface working contact, sweep direction, operator configuration and active phase retained
swath.P3: Existing view already shows that working contact and adjacent surface
swath.O4: Same dry debris can form the optional modest ridge and relatively cleared swath on that same surface
swath.O5: Adjacency aligns with that same contact/direction without new geometry, material, phase or framing

pan.P1: Existing operator and same broom/hand brush collecting existing loose dry debris from the same surface into the same pan
pan.P2: Already seated lip against source surface; source, lip and pan interior already visible together
pan.P3: Active collection already has debris on the source and inside pan; configuration, approach, contacts, receiver position and phase retained
pan.O4: Sparse source remainder, a few grains at lip and modest interior deposit remain the same existing debris, with no new fine constituent or conversion
pan.O5: All three regions belong to the established source-to-pan collection and supporting contact
